description: All results for one lab test over time, with units, reference range, and a low/normal/high flag, plus the doc_id of the lab report it came from. The test must be an exact name from signal_list_tracked, e.g. ferritin, hemoglobin, tsh.

configuration.query: FROM health-timeline | WHERE kind == "lab" AND name == ?test | KEEP @timestamp, name, value, unit, ref_low, ref_high, flag, doc_id | SORT @timestamp ASC

test.description: Exact lab test name from signal_list_tracked, e.g. ferritin
